properties.name: scanrest.file
properties.description: Path to the YAML test specification file.

properties.name: scanrest.mode
properties.description: Execution mode: LIVE (HTTP), MOCKMVC (Spring MockMvc), or EMBEDDED (deprecated alias for MOCKMVC).

properties.name: scanrest.base-url
properties.description: Base URL override for live mode.

properties.name: scanrest.auto-generate
properties.description: Auto-scan controllers and generate YAML skeleton if file doesn't exist.

properties.name: scanrest.fail-on-error
properties.description: Whether to fail the build/test phase when tests fail.

properties.name: scanrest.report-path
properties.description: Path to write a test report file.

properties.name: scanrest.run-on-startup
properties.description: Run tests automatically on application startup.

properties.name: scanrest.mock-services
properties.description: Auto-mock all @Service beans with Mockito (for MOCKMVC mode). Requires Mockito on the classpath.

values.description: Execute tests via HTTP against a running server (requires @SpringBootTest with RANDOM_PORT).
Execute tests using Spring MockMvc from the existing context. Supports @MockBean, @WebMvcTest, @ActiveProfiles.
